reviewedBy: Claude Opus 5 — verified the prefetch defect against production before changing the tracking path
method: Proved empirically that the /photo/[id] server load records a view on prefetch: one GET of /photo/<key>/__data.json added exactly one engagement_events row. Moved view reporting to the page component via the existing /api/engagement client path, so it fires on render rather than on hover. Also corrected photo.id on this route from image_key to photo_id, matching transformPhotoRow — DownloadButton passes photo.id, so download events from this page had been writing image_keys into engagement_events.photo_id. Removed the now-dead trackPhotoView. No reader-facing copy changed.
